**No more "AGGRO!" warnings while you're solo.**

## Fixed
- **Solo "AGGRO!" warnings are gone.** Wrekkit watches every mob in combat around you and warns when one turns on someone who isn't the tank. Solo, every mob you fight is on you, so it fired all through questing. It now only warns in a party or raid. The mob window still marks those mobs the same as before.

## Install

Download `Wrekkit-0.9.18.zip` and extract it into `<your client>\Interface\AddOns\`. You should end up with `Interface\AddOns\Wrekkit\Wrekkit.toc`. Do **not** use the "Source code" links. Coming from 0.9.16 or earlier, **fully restart the client** (0.9.17 added a file); from 0.9.17 a `/reload` is enough. `/wrek status` should then report **v0.9.18**.

## Requirements

- **Nampower** is required for the damage meter, the report and the per-raid files. The threat meter itself works without it.
- **SuperWoW** is recommended.
- **aux** for consumable prices (optional).
